messages.author: 4ddc99c6029ba75d
messages.subject: legend.position question
parts:
Hi:
Just updated to the latest version of ggplot2 and is really great
( Thanks Hadley). Now that legen.position works,
is there a way to set the angle just like geom_text()?


qplot(factor(cyl), data=mtcars, geom="bar", fill=factor(cyl)) +
opts(legend.position="bottom",angle=90)

messages.author: dc06d729e023580a
messages.subject: Re: legend.position question
parts:
What would expect that to do? Rotate the entire legend, or the text in
the labels? I'm not sure in what context either of those behaviours
would be useful.

Hadley
